title: Restriction of scalars along a finite flat algebra preserves finite projectivity
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings such that $B$ is finite, finitely presented [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra], and flat as an $A$-module [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Let $M$ be a $B$-module that is finitely presented [def-sc-finitely-presented-module] and projective over $B$ [def-weil-pbc-projective-module]. Regard $M$ as an $A$-module through $A\to B$. Then $M$ is finitely presented and projective over $A$.
